reply_text: @Sofia, it was **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living, your Mid-Atlantic home goods account). The lamp delivery at door 6 was on that account, and the Pellucid Harbor Logistics rows were the Gulf Coast container pickups. You and Kwame settled this in #coastal-team on 17 February, after the rename from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living.
